extracted.name: Slow Cooker Beef and Barley Soup
extracted.description: This hearty slow cooker beef and barley soup simmers low and slow for rich flavor with minimal hands-on time.
instruction_lines: Place beef bones in a large size slow cooker. Add salt, celery stalks, onion, bouquets garni sachets, pepper, carrots, parsley and garlic. Fill slow cooker within 2 inches of the top with hot water and cook for 6 hours, covered on high heat, stirring occasionally.
Add barley and cook for 2 more hours stirring occasionally or until meat can easily be removed from bones.
Remove and discard onion, bouquets garni sachets, celery, and parsley.
Transfer bones to a dish and remove meat from bones, being careful not to take off cartilage or gristle. Place meat back into soup, stir, and serve.
